description: `useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, getServerSnapshot?)` subscribes a component to a store outside React without tearing.
The value `getSnapshot` returns. React compares consecutive snapshots with `Object.is`; it must be cached.
A visual inconsistency where components in one render show different versions of the same external data.
A selector whose result is reused while its inputs, or an equality check, say nothing changed.
One-level comparison of arrays or objects with `Object.is` on each value.
Returns the value used during server rendering and hydration, usually the initial state.
